findings.subject: Unreachable writing unit
findings.finding: All24 factories set connectedFormulaResearch. InitializeResearch returns at SharedFormulaResearch.cs129 when this flag is true, before writing supply creation130-131. No selected admitted descendant route creates a writing unit; copying is explicitly rejected. The table row incorrectly describes a common selected connected initialization.
findings.correction: Remove writing-allotment-1sp from this selected table and retain an explicit unselected-profile exclusion. Keep existing wider research native source intact.

findings.subject: Per-field binding must replace broad common inventory label
findings.finding: physical.portable.currentQuantity occurs only in HandlePortableEquipment, OpenPortableContainer, ClosePortableContainer, EquipPortableItem and RemovePortableItem groups; it uses J_REQUEST and the actual selected target. Native host712-717 requires an actual permitted portable item (or admitted companion Club). Three ingredient units and supplementary glass-vial stock are real but unlinked InventoryLots, not targets of these five operation routes. Their Nutrition.None, non-mass units have no selected counted storage profile and RegisterInventoryLot295 returns. They also fail Purify nutrition guards.
findings.correction: Give each unit an exact applicable field and root/descendant branch. Only five ResourceLot units have a reachable portable/Purify field branch. Retain other real common source units as out-of-field-scope census rows, not claimed current field bindings and not new blanket P_ITEM permission.

findings.subject: Two inherited public-item units omitted from whole-world census, but do not expand the requested field
findings.finding: All24 selected worlds initialize prototype.camp-greens.seed-packet and prototype.suitable-water.pint as owned/custodied Companion InventoryLots. ProjectItems672-678 can show their unlinked amounts. They are not potable water, never the ten-table water alias. Neither is an admitted portable target or Purify target.
findings.correction: Record both explicit inherited-but-out-of-field-scope units. Do not add them as available values of this portable/Purify fact merely because P_ITEM displays their magnitudes. If a future separate generic item Quantity field is added, it requires an explicit approved binding rather than silently inheriting this table.

Equip/Remove focus has null native availability, not any lot unit. Open/Close may have a typed denial for an actual lot target but does not establish container usability.
scopeResolution.doseBranch: Separately approved ItemCount for actual linked/loose-dose availability, not one of the ResourceLot UnitIds; linked spent dose0 preserved, loose spent dose undiscoverable.
scopeResolution.nullBranch: Actual authorized non-lot/non-dose native Available=null is NotApplicable; withheld source/unit is never relabeled NotApplicable.

rightsAndTemporalRequirements: Conjoin current endpoint/principal, exact selected factory/profile, J_REQUEST/actual causal receipt where required, actual current item route, exact producer/lineage and listed unit. No unit string alone permission.

For InventoryLot branch join actual InventoryLotRecord.OwnerId through MayUseInventory and actual ResourceLot.CustodianId through Controls; preserve linked portable OwnerId/CustodianId predicates too. ParentId identity is not automatically disclosed by allowing the child unit.

Cache: physical.portable.currentQuantity never substitutes P_CACHE_STOCK to bypass portable KnownTarget. Separate explicitly permitted cache quantity path requires ReachableCache + Open + exact root location/custody/title and AvailableCacheRations. Closed/inaccessible cache units/counts remain undisclosed.

Current quantity is Work.AvailableAmount actual selected lot, not ResourceLot.Amount, held capacity or historic consumed total. Total lot amount is used only for fresh accepted Purify whole-lot fact after native whole-lot prerequisites; available equals total is a native busy guard.
Foreign buyer/vendor stock remains withheld despite transaction mandate. Actual transfer plus current title/custody is necessary. A later loss of current rights revokes public current disclosure.

Purify fresh actual pre-cast whole-lot amount/unit is captured during authoritative submission. Do not use a current amount as historical. Later missing actual amount is NotRetained only after authorization; contamination removal existence/count/kinds stays fixed Withheld.

No available Value for unresolved/nonpublic unit; fixed Withheld no naked magnitude, guessed FoodUnit, fallback dimension or hidden-unit reason. Actual authorized native null remains NotApplicable. Missing required known binding is a qualification defect, not a waiver.

No public hidden count or unit-census output: counts in this private source audit are design verification only. No current rights come from operator clock grant, selected class rank, constructor defaults or native availability of another fixture.

descendantAndTransferProof.proof: Actual child preserves parent ResourceLot.UnitId and InventoryLot nutrition/title/freshness, while distinct child custody/access/location are explicit. Unsafe contamination stops descendant creation. Current descendant alone not ancestor identity grant.
Actual completed job releases reservation and calls Descendant(source, job.output); unit comes from actual source, not anticipated output or destination vessel.
Host/runtime still enforces selected target, nutrition/counted-profile, actual available amount, reach and downstream capacity. Generic descendant method is not admission authority.

Native physical movement preserves actual UnitId while replacing location/custodian; title transfer updates InventoryLot owner and physical owner/custodian. It does not create a new currency, food or mining material unit.
Initial recipe4 component UnitIds are material stock. Actual finished-dose projection is AlchemyDose and ItemCount, never ing-* or ordinary.glass-vial-1gp availability by inference.
